summary: Verify unchanged snapshot imports without granting repair ownership

delivery.outcome: Treat pinned unchanged snapshot imports as historical context; retain ordinary repair scope, ownership, budget and independent approval.
nonGoals: Issue or consume production migration grants in the standard
Rewrite preserved source refs or alter ordinary scope/budget/review requirements
Take over peer worktrees or modify adopter repositories before independent publication

architecture.decision: Use successful exact-source proof to distinguish import history from repairs; even an import-only candidate requires normal independent exact-head approval.
interfaceChanges: Verified import paths in ordinary governance validation
architecture.rollback: Revert reviewed standard change; preserve all reservations, original sources and candidate refs.

validation.evidence: Real Git proof and scope/budget/approval regression fixtures.
